title: 911: Flash Report on Canal Street — No Explosion

callee.name: Gordon Haskell (VP Gas Operations, Incident Commander)
callee.label: IC

transcript.speaker: 911 Dispatch
transcript.text: Control, this is 911 Dispatch. A resident on Maple Street just called to report a loud boom and a flash on Canal Street. They said it looked like an explosion. We’ve sent a patrol car, but no fire or damage. Corwin Fire says they’ve found no evidence of a rupture. We’re not sure what to tell the public now—media is asking.

transcript.speaker: IC
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm with Corwin Fire on the ground. We have no rupture, no confirmed explosion. I’ll direct PIO to issue a correction.

voiceStyles.911 Dispatch: Woman in her 30s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter
voiceStyles.IC: Man in his 50s, deliberate, authoritative, calm but firm

instructorNote: This inject introduces media and public confusion. The IC must confirm facts with Corwin Fire and instruct PIO to correct the public alert to prevent panic from false reports.
